$about: The release recipe read by cut-release. The program takes its version from PROJECT_VERSION through the GROUNDWORK_VERSION define. The RPM spec's Version: and the OBS _service tag move with it, because packaging/obs/obs-submit.sh refuses them out of step (GRND-0031). Every release ends with the OBS step, by hand, after the tag is on GitHub: run packaging/obs/obs-submit.sh, then packaging/obs/obs-status.sh, whose exit 0 means every target built and ran the tests. publish_precheck checks osc can reach the OBS package before anything is bumped. The AppImage is the GitHub release's one asset. Phase 2's build does not make it, so a todo builds it from the bumped tree, deleting any earlier one first so a stale AppImage cannot pass the artifacts check (GRND-0103).
todos: Build the AppImage from the bumped tree: rm -f build/appimage/Groundwork-x86_64.AppImage && nice -n 19 packaging/appimage/build-appimage.sh
